peg.peg_mechanism_score_basis: MEASURES THE MECHANISM, NOT THE −2.6bp DEVIATION. 1:1 PYUSD mint/redeem is a fiat-backed-with-redemption design, which is the strongest mechanism class in this corpus. ⚠️ THE SCORE INHERITS PYUSD'S OWN MECHANISM RISK — a 1:1 redemption into PYUSD is only as good as PYUSD's redemption, so this 7.0 rests on a second issuer's arrangement and is not independent of it.

backing.backing_score_basis: MEASURES RESERVE QUALITY AND CUSTODY LOCATION, NOT THE RATIO — which is an identity. ✅ THE STRONG FACT IS CUSTODY: the reserve is PYUSD held DIRECTLY IN THE USDai CONTRACT, so the assets are where a reader can see them rather than at an unwalked portal layer. That is precisely what usdat LOST in its 2026-08-19 rotation, and it is why these two assets score differently on similar-looking ratios. Quality is high: PYUSD is regulated and T-Bill backed. ⚠️ THE FEED'S collateral_ratio 100.0 WITH A SURPLUS OF $0.92 ON $290,117,769.24 IS AN ACCOUNTING IDENTITY — ninety-two cents of surplus on a $290M book is rounding, and backing is defined as PYUSD held against supply. The ratio carries no information; THE CUSTODY LOCATION DOES, and that is what the 7.0 prices.
backing.backing_score_persistence: filtered — reserve quality and custody, not a spot ratio
backing.backing_score_denominator: ⚠️ backing = PYUSD held = supply by construction, so the quotient cannot print anything but ~100. Never quote '100% collateralized' here as though it were a solvency measurement.

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: ⚠️ THE WEAK DIMENSION, AND IT IS THE ONE TO READ FIRST ON THIS ASSET. USDai/USDC Curve under ~$2M plus a thin Uni V4 pool; no CEX; the retail path is the constraint. ⚠️ ~$2M OF VENUE AGAINST A $290,117,769.24 BOOK — under 0.7% — so peg 7.0 and backing 7.0 describe an asset most holders cannot exit at scale. The three axes are not in tension; they answer different questions and only one of them is about getting out.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — venue structure, not spot depth
liquidity.liquidity_score_depth_caveat: ⚠️ THE FEED'S total_2pct_depth OF $2,000,000 IS NOT A MEASUREMENT: is_floor true, status 'ladder_exhausted' — the ladder ran out without resolving a 2% crossing. It coincides with the ~$2M venue figure, ⚠️ AND THE COINCIDENCE IS NOT CORROBORATION: a ladder that exhausts at its top rung reports that rung, so agreement with the pool size is arithmetic, not confirmation.

issuer.issuer_score_basis: MEASURES THE ENTITY. Credible VC backing (Framework, Dragonfly, Coinbase Ventures, Arbitrum) and a MetaStreet lineage. ⚠️ VC BACKING IS EVIDENCE ABOUT DILIGENCE AT A POINT IN TIME, NOT AN ONGOING CONTROL — it does not constrain what the issuer can do after the round, and it is scored as reputation rather than as a mitigant.
